name: vnbrokers-opencollection
description: OpenAPI specifications and bundled build artifacts for vnbrokers.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:fhsc && npm run lint:dnse && npm run lint:dnse:asyncapi && npm run lint:ssi:asyncapi && npm run lint:tcbs && npm run lint:entrade && npm run lint:ssi
scripts.bundle:dnse: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/v2/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse-v2.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/v2/openapi.yaml -o dist/dnse-v2.json
scripts.bundle:dnse:asyncapi: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @asyncapi/cli@5.0.7 bundle openapi/vi/DNSE/v2/asyncapi/asyncapi.yaml --output dist/dnse-v2-asyncapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:ssi:asyncapi: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @asyncapi/cli@5.0.7 bundle openapi/vi/SSI/v3/asyncapi/asyncapi.yaml --output dist/ssi-v3-asyncapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:fhsc: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/v0/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc-v0.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/FHSC/v0/openapi.yaml -o dist/fhsc-v0.json
scripts.bundle:tcbs: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs-v1.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/TCBS/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/tcbs-v1.json
scripts.bundle:entrade: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade-v1.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/Entrade/v1/openapi.yaml -o dist/entrade-v1.json
scripts.bundle:ssi: mkdir -p dist && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/SSI/v3/openapi.yaml -o dist/ssi-v3.yaml && npx --yes @redocly/cli@2.46.1 bundle openapi/vi/SSI/v3/openapi.yaml -o dist/ssi-v3.json
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:fhsc && npm run bundle:dnse && npm run bundle:dnse:asyncapi && npm run bundle:ssi:asyncapi && npm run bundle:tcbs && npm run bundle:entrade && npm run bundle:ssi
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run bundle
